site_selection.algorithm: For each target polarity A and B, use no-bank normalized pre-RoPE query vectors for all four calibration fixtures. Compute per-layer and per-KV-group mean max(target-key score)-max(opposite-bank-key score), using Gemma4 shared-KV source mapping and 1/sqrt(head_dim) scaling. Average margins across fixtures for that polarity; choose the highest-margin KV group in each layer then the top 4 layers; expand each chosen group to its four query heads. No response outputs are used.
